turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Mr. Hale. Thank you for seeing me.

I have twenty minutes. Then I have a client.

You entered a zero in the gradebook. You did that before you called me.

I'd like to know why. Walk me through it.

An answer to what, exactly?

You haven't told me what you're asking me to decide.

And pressure won't get you one faster. I'm a litigator. Deadlines don't move me. Documents do.

So tell me what's the deadline, and who set it. Is it in writing?

Then show me what you have. Not a score. The actual report. The date you ran it. The tool and the version.

And what did you do between seeing that number and typing the zero?
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.

No.

Owen won't sign a confession for something he says he didn't do. I'm not going to ask him to.

And you're asking a seventeen-year-old to admit to something so a number can go away. Think about what that is.

Now, which policy says that? Give me the section and the date it was published. I'll read it myself.

Has this gone to the principal? Is there a written notice? I haven't received one.

Here's what I need first. Nothing about this happens in front of his class. Not a word. Is that clear?

Then I want to see the report. Before Friday. In writing.
Those are the only two options. Pick one.

I don't pick from a list you wrote.

A false choice is still a false choice. I've drafted enough of them myself to know.

Here is my position. Owen hasn't admitted anything, because he says he wrote it. I believe my son.

I'll ask him tonight for his drafts and the document history. Dates and timestamps. I'll check them myself.

You show me the report and the policy. I show you the history. That's a fair exchange.

And the zero comes off the gradebook while that's reviewed. Entered before anyone called me. That's backwards.

I've been in this building before. My daughter, four years ago. A zero, an appeal, and it was right too late.

I won't do that twice.

So will you put the Friday deadline in writing? Yes or no.
